effect.name: S_Glint
effect.desc: O S_Glint do After Effects (Sapphire): estrelas de oito pontas saindo das áreas claras, com as cores abrindo em arco-íris ao longo do raio.
effect.desc-en: After Effects' S_Glint (Sapphire): eight-pointed stars streaking out of the bright areas, with the colours fanning into a rainbow along each ray.
